description.value: The Goldstream Suspension Bridge is a striking pedestrian and cycling feature spanning a forested river gorge in the greater Goldstream/Sooke Hills wilderness area west of Victoria. It sits along a popular trail network managed by the Capital Regional District and serves as a scenic highlight on the Vancouver Crossing Loop route. Touring cyclists passing through the region frequently use it as a landmark waypoint amid old-growth Douglas fir and western red cedar.
